title: Build the stable Pico–Franka release repository
goal: Create Release as a clean local Git repository containing only the validated single-arm Franka/Pico teleoperation and collection product, with vendored required source, reproducible environment metadata, stable tests, and operational documentation.
doneWhen: Release is an independent local Git repository derived only from approved committed baselines.
Release contains the bounded Pico single-arm Franka collection product, including its stable launcher, preflight, collection, quality-check, and legacy LeRobot conversion paths.
Experimental, diagnostic, unrelated RLinf features, caches, build artifacts, and obsolete materials are excluded from Release.
The Pico source is vendored with its license retained, and external dependencies have an explicit reproducibility and licensing inventory.
Release has stable tests and documentation sufficient to install and operate the supported workflow, with automated verification appropriate to the migration.
decisions: Release is a new independent local Git repository under /home/modelbest/Project/RLinf-Franka/Release.
The supported product boundary is Pico teleoperation and human-demonstration collection for one Franka Research 3 arm only.
Source enters Release only from approved committed baselines; current uncommitted development changes are excluded.
Approved baselines are RLinf e7a9a2e and RLinf-Franks 803ba2a; Pico software is vendored from its committed source snapshot after inventory confirms the exact commit and licenses.
The legacy pickle-to-LeRobot converter is included; the unimplemented LeRobot v3 collection design is excluded.
Stable tests are included; temporary experiments, diagnostics, caches, build outputs, and unrelated framework features are excluded.

Python environments are managed with uv; distributable third-party source retains its license, while non-vendorable system/vendor dependencies are documented with version and installation instructions.
Approved business and technical boundaries are recorded in .vibe/requirements.md.
Release uses vendored core/rlinf, extensions/rig, pico_bridge, configs, scripts, tests, docs, and licenses; only the Pico single-arm workflow is exposed or supported.

verification.summary: Release initial commit 77213e4 completed after repository structure, generated uv locks, focused integrity tests, Python compilation, shell syntax, and dependency-closure imports passed.
checks: Python compilation for Release scripts, rig extension, and Pico bridge passed
Shell syntax checks for stable launchers and adapted RLinf collector passed
uv.lock and pico_bridge/uv.lock resolved and passed uv lock --check
Release-owned whitespace check passed; nested Git metadata and ignored artifact checks passed
Approved baseline commit references and expected collector adaptation were verified
RLinf real-world collection and LeRobot writer imports resolved from the Release layout
limitations: No hardware, Franky/libfranka, vendor Pico SDK, camera, Robotiq, or end-to-end collection run was exercised.
